sources.title: KSREC GeoServer (WFS): local-body boundaries, watershed atlas, wetlands, paddy, notified wetland parcels, flood extents and quarries of Kerala
sources.publisher: Kerala State Remote Sensing and Environment Centre (KSREC)
sources.license: No licence or terms are stated on the GeoServer (WFS capabilities: AccessConstraints NONE). Served with attribution to KSREC by the maintainer's decision; layers KSREC derived from OpenStreetMap (quarries, waterbodies) carry ODbL 1.0.

provenance.note: Palakkad district's rivers, reservoirs, wetlands and groundwater (scope palakkad-rivers; the district's own scope id is kl-palakkad). The district is the union of its local bodies in KSREC's layer and the catchments (shedId) are the river basins of KSREC's watershed atlas cut to it. KSREC publishes no licence and its layers are served with attribution; its quarry layer is OpenStreetMap's (ODbL).
